review_method: Independent read-only prospective control review with a final-byte re-review after the data-boundary correction.

answers.basis: The bound June disposition rejects June reads, a controlled plan, controlled evaluation, and a substitute range.

The ten frozen families cover every required direction with causal completed-bar inputs and sparse entry rules.
Ten families each expand two axes to six parents, for 60 exact configurations under the 800-parent ceiling.
Normal and zero-cost pairs are frozen, the calibrated model and its passed review are hash-bound, and daily SEC, TAF, and CAT accounting is explicit.
Return, fold consistency, drawdown, turnover, cost efficiency, gross edge, holding time, symbol concentration, and accounting thresholds are fixed before results.
All serious candidates require Stress A, Stress B, isolated delay-2 and delay-3, every immediate neighbor, and uniform cohort selection with at most one candidate per family.
An empty cohort closes as failed exposed evidence. A nonempty cohort freezes and stops without controlled qualification. No Exposed 002 runner or CLI exists in this slice.
